item: Static checks run as their own job beside the test legs (R668)
summary: Leg 1 of test ran every static gate around pytest and was the run's critical path (20.9 vs 18.3/17.5 min on run 42944433508); they are now the static job on their own runner with the legs' install line, test-all needs it and requires success; overhead_seconds stays 80 so the file deal does not move (a re-deal to 0 exposed two order-dependent tests on its first run).
